semiconductor_relevance: High — Cameca SAS specializes in advanced metrology solutions and analytical instrumentation critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Cameca SAS provides high-precision scientific instrumentation and metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on techniques such as Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS) and Electron Probe MicroAnalysis (EPMA). Their products are designed to enhance analytical performance in semiconductor fabrication and research applications.
capabilities: Low energy Electron induced X-ray Emission Spectrometry (LEXES)

regional_presence.United States: Cameca has an Atom Probe Technology Center located in Madison, Wisconsin, enhancing its presence in the U.S. market.
regional_presence.France: The company is headquartered near Paris, France, where it manages design and manufacturing operations.
